description: Establish the foundation: bring the missing api-mocks reference HTML and the NEXT_AGENT_HANDOFF content onto the branch (they live on branch docs/amazon-sandbox-handoff, NOT on this worktree branch which was cut from main); make docs/PROJECT_STATUS_MATRIX.md the single source of truth for status facts (define EIF SHA-256, PCR0/1/2, host facts, stacks, verified request/evidence IDs ONCE here); remove the committed binary PDF from version control and add a .gitignore. In the matrix status table, expand on first use: EIF (Enclave Image File), PCR (Platform Configuration Register), COSE (CBOR Object Signing and Encryption), CBOR (Concise Binary Object Representation), TLSNotary, attestation, vsock (virtual socket). Correct the two Blocked rows that are now stale: keep 'real TLSNotary proof' as the honest open gate (the enclave still runs a tlsnotary hash-contract PLACEHOLDER - true in EnclaveService.java), but change any row/text implying the Amazon SP-API sandbox is unavailable/blocked to state that sandbox endpoints and credentials are now available for validation (credentials provided out of band / stored as secrets - never write values).
